use std::error::Error;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use matrix_sdk::Client;
use matrix_sdk::SessionMeta;
use matrix_sdk::SessionTokens;
use matrix_sdk::authentication::matrix::MatrixSession;
use matrix_sdk::ruma::api::MatrixVersion;
use matrix_sdk::store::StateStoreDataKey;
use matrix_sdk::store::StateStoreDataValue;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let root = PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).ok_or("fixture output path")?);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;
    let session = MatrixSession {
        meta: SessionMeta {
            user_id: "@agent:example.test".try_into()?,
            device_id: "COMPATDEVICE".into(),
        },
        tokens: SessionTokens {
            access_token: "compatibility-fixture-access-token".into(),
            refresh_token: Some("compatibility-fixture-refresh-token".into()),
        },
    };
    let client = Client::builder()
        .homeserver_url("https://example.test")
        .server_versions([MatrixVersion::V1_12])
        .sqlite_store_with_cache_path(
            root.join("state"),
            root.join("cache"),
            Some("compatibility-fixture-passphrase"),
        )
        .build()
        .await?;
    client.restore_session(session.clone()).await?;
    client
        .state_store()
        .set_kv_data(
            StateStoreDataKey::Filter("compat-filter"),
            StateStoreDataValue::Filter("legacy-filter-id".into()),
        )
        .await?;
    client
        .state_store()
        .set_kv_data(
            StateStoreDataKey::SyncToken,
            StateStoreDataValue::SyncToken("legacy-sdk-cursor".into()),
        )
        .await?;
    let metadata = serde_json::json!({
        "session": session,
        "ed25519_key": client.encryption().ed25519_key().await.ok_or("device identity")?,
        "curve25519_key": client.encryption().curve25519_key().await.ok_or("device encryption key")?.to_base64(),
        "passphrase": "compatibility-fixture-passphrase",
        "filter_name": "compat-filter",
        "filter_id": "legacy-filter-id",
        "sdk_sync_token": "legacy-sdk-cursor",
    });
    std::fs::write(root.join("metadata.json"), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&metadata)?)?;
    drop(client);
    println!("Created ordinary encrypted Matrix 0.18 persistence fixture");
    Ok(())
}
